adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: SGLT1 does not hydrolyze ATP directly; it uses the inward sodium gradient maintained by basolateral Na+/K+ ATPase to drive glucose/galactose uptake.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Basolateral Na+/K+ ATPase uses ATP, but the immediate apical driving force is the sodium electrochemical gradient it creates. This distinction keeps the answer at the requested transport-mechanism granularity.
